title: The Wise Men Follow the Star
book: The New Testament, January 2027 (Come and See!)
p1: Wise men in the east saw a new star. It meant a new King was born. They came a long way to worship Him.
King Herod heard about them and was upset. He wanted to be the only king. He said, “Find the child, then come tell me.” But Herod did not mean well.
The star went ahead and stopped over the house where Jesus was. The wise men were so happy! They bowed down and worshipped Him.
p2: They gave Jesus treasures: gold, and sweet-smelling frankincense and myrrh. Then Heavenly Father warned them in a dream, so they went home another way.
The wise men gave Jesus their best. Tonight, give Jesus a gift too, like a kind word or a helping hand.
note: Rewritten the picture-book way and rated 9-10 by a reviewer that did not write it (29 Oct 2026).
